title: Policy Declaration Page
description: Policy Declaration Page contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-insurance-policy-declaration-page
  title: Policy Declaration Page
  description: Policy Declaration Page contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
  version: insurance_policy_declaration_page_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: insurance/policy_declaration_page
    sourcePath: Schemas/insurance/policy_declaration_page
    sourceVersion: insurance_policy_declaration_page_v1
    sourceDigest: 986ebfb387a2a113932169e7e59c64f319703cca19faa9246ed02f84b432333c
spec:
  documentType: policy_declaration_page
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - cancellation-notice-days
        - forms-and-endorsements
        - policy-period-end
        - policy-period-start
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - deductibles
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - premium-total
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - coverage-lines
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - additional-insured-names
        - carrier-name
        - loss-payee-names
        - named-insured
        - producer-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - covered-property-or-risk
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - coverage-limits
        - policy-number
  fields:
    - id: policy-number
      name: policy_number
      label: Policy Number
      description: Insurance policy number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/policy_number
    - id: named-insured
      name: named_insured
      label: Named Insured
      description: Named insured on the declaration page.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/named_insured
    - id: carrier-name
      name: carrier_name
      label: Carrier Name
      description: Insurance carrier or underwriting company.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/carrier_name
    - id: producer-name
      name: producer_name
      label: Producer Name
      description: Agent, broker, or producer name.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/producer_name
    - id: policy-period-start
      name: policy_period_start
      label: Policy Period Start
      description: Policy period start date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/policy_period_start
    - id: policy-period-end
      name: policy_period_end
      label: Policy Period End
      description: Policy period end date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/policy_period_end
    - id: coverage-lines
      name: coverage_lines
      label: Coverage Lines
      description: Coverage lines shown on the declaration page.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/coverage_lines
    - id: covered-property-or-risk
      name: covered_property_or_risk
      label: Covered Property Or Risk
      description: Covered property, vehicle, operation, or risk.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/covered_property_or_risk
    - id: coverage-limits
      name: coverage_limits
      label: Coverage Limits
      description: Coverage limit items by line or coverage.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/coverage_limits
    - id: deductibles
      name: deductibles
      label: Deductibles
      description: Deductible items by line or coverage.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/deductibles
    - id: premium-total
      name: premium_total
      label: Premium Total
      description: Total policy premium.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/premium_total
    - id: additional-insured-names
      name: additional_insured_names
      label: Additional Insured Names
      description: Additional insureds shown on the declarations.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/additional_insured_names
    - id: loss-payee-names
      name: loss_payee_names
      label: Loss Payee Names
      description: Loss payees, mortgagees, or lender loss payable parties.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/loss_payee_names
    - id: forms-and-endorsements
      name: forms_and_endorsements
      label: Forms And Endorsements
      description: Policy forms and endorsements listed.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/forms_and_endorsements
    - id: cancellation-notice-days
      name: cancellation_notice_days
      label: Cancellation Notice Days
      description: Number of cancellation notice days if stated.
      dataType: integer
      sourcePath: /fields/cancellation_notice_days
  validationRules:
    - id: policy-number-present
      severity: error
      description: policy_number is required for Policy Declaration Page extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: policy_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: policy_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: policy_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(policy_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: named-insured-present
      severity: error
      description: named_insured is required for Policy Declaration Page extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: named_insured
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: named_insured
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: named_insured IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(named_insured)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: carrier-name-present
      severity: error
      description: carrier_name is required for Policy Declaration Page extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: carrier_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: carrier_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: carrier_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(carrier_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: premium-total-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: premium_total should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: premium_total
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: premium_total
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: premium_total IS NULL OR premium_total >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      policy_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Policy Declaration Page workflow.
      named_insured:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Policy Declaration Page workflow.
      policy_period_start:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Policy Declaration Page workflow.
      policy_period_end:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Policy Declaration Page workflow.
      carrier_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Policy declaration page extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Policy Declaration Page documents mix policy, coverage, claim, party, financial, and regulatory
      notice context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      policy_number:
        type: string
        description: Insurance policy number.
      named_insured:
        type: string
        description: Named insured on the declaration page.
      carrier_name:
        type: string
        description: Insurance carrier or underwriting company.
      producer_name:
        type: string
        description: Agent, broker, or producer name.
      policy_period_start:
        type: date
        description: Policy period start date.
        format: date
      policy_period_end:
        type: date
        description: Policy period end date.
        format: date
      coverage_lines:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Coverage lines shown on the declaration page.
      covered_property_or_risk:
        type: string
        description: Covered property, vehicle, operation, or risk.
      coverage_limits:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            coverage_limit_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for coverage_limits item.
            coverage_limit_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for coverage_limits item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Coverage limit items by line or coverage.
      deductibles:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            deductible_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for deductibles item.
            deductible_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for deductibles item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Deductible items by line or coverage.
      premium_total:
        type: number
        description: Total policy premium.
      additional_insured_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Additional insureds shown on the declarations.
      loss_payee_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Loss payees, mortgagees, or lender loss payable parties.
      forms_and_endorsements:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Policy forms and endorsements listed.
      cancellation_notice_days:
        type: integer
        description: Number of cancellation notice days if stated.
    required:
      - policy_number
      - named_insured
      - carrier_name
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: insurance_collateral_protection
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - policy_number
          - named_insured
          - carrier_name
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - coverage_limits
          - deductibles
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
